name: Dana Kippel
abstract_title: Phenomenology of Plasma-Consciousness Synergy: Toward a Unified Experiential Framework
abstract: This paper explores plasma as a potential phenomenological medium of consciousness. Building on biophysical research in quantum brain biology and microtubule coherence, I propose that subjective experiences of luminosity, flow, and coherence correspond to dynamic plasma-like processes within and beyond the nervous system. notable: Author of 'A New Force: Plasma, Consciousness, and the New Human Potential'; filmmaker and mental health advocate
notes: No formal academic credentials. Proposes plasma as sentient consciousness-carrying medium.
